name: Xi'an Taijin New Energy & Materials Sci-Tech Co., Ltd.
summary: Xi'an Taijin New Energy & Materials Sci-Tech Co., Ltd. engages in the research, design, development, production, and sale of high-end intelligent electrolytic copper foil complete equipment and titanium electrode materials. It offers all-in-one raw foil machines, surfaces treatment machines, cathode drums, anode tanks, copper foil anodes, sodium hypochlorite generators, modular disinfections, high efficiency copper dissolution tanks, anodes for chlorination, PEM titanium felts and porous titanium products, PEM titanium bipolar plates, platinum plated anodes, descaling anodes, cathodic protection products, and multi anodes.
